scene.label: An explanation comparing integer addition and string joining.

explanation.title: Add integers
explanation.text: The result is 7. With integers (whole numbers), + adds.

explanation.title: Join strings
explanation.text: The result is "34". With strings (text), + joins.

explanation.title: Build a greeting
explanation.text: username stores a string, so joining it to "Hello " makes "Hello Ola". Keep the space after Hello!
